title: Canonical derived coefficient adjunct on a single object
statement:
Let $l$ be prime, $E$ a finite dimensional extension field of $\mathbf Q_l$, $f:X\to S$ a morphism of schemes with diagonal localizations, and $p$ a presentation [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-presentation]. Write $N_X,N_S$ for the coefficient systems and $a:L\dashv F$ for its ordinary geometric adjunction. Let $\theta:L N_S\simeq N_X$ be the specified coefficient pullback and $\theta_D$ its specified derived localization [def-sp-tower-class-diagonal]. If $s_T$ denotes placement in degree zero and $\rho_F(N_X):s_S(FN_X)\to R_F(s_XN_X)$ is the canonical ordinary-to-derived single-object arrow [lem-diagonal-canonical-right-derived], then
\[a_D^{\flat}(\theta_D)=s_S(a^{\flat}(\theta))\,\rho_F(N_X).\]
Here $a_D$ is the canonical derived adjunction, and composition is in application order.

proof.text: The coefficient derived pullback is the exact single-functor comparison followed by localization of the ordinary coefficient isomorphism.

The cochain unit of the canonical derived adjunction is the ordinary unit followed by the right cochain unit. Evaluate on a single complex and apply naturality to the ordinary coefficient isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalTrace_coefficient_single_adjunct
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S]
    {f : X ⟶ S} (p : Presentation l E f) :
    let := p.base.kinjective X
    let := p.model.geometry.pushAdditive
    ((SpTowerShriek.adjunction l E p.base p.model.geometry).homEquiv _ _
        (p.model.coefficientPullback.derivedIso l E).hom) =
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SpTowerClasses.Systems S (SpTowerClasses.Arings l E S)) 0).map
        ((p.model.geometry.ordinaryAdjunction.homEquiv _ _)
          p.model.coefficientPullback.iso.hom) ≫
        diagonalTraceRightSingle p.model.geometry.push
          (canonicalDiagonalRightDerived p.model.geometry.push)
          (SpTowerClasses.coefficient X (SpTowerClasses.Arings l E X))
